name: Caulking
summary: Flexible sealant that closes gaps around tubs, sinks, windows, and trim.
education: Caulk is the first line of defense against water intrusion. It cracks and pulls away over time, especially around tubs and showers where movement and constant moisture stress the seal. Refreshing caulk is cheap; the rot it prevents is expensive.

questions.prompt: Where is this run of caulk?

suggested_photos.prompt: Any visible gaps, mold, or pulling away

maintenance.action: Inspect for cracks, gaps, or mold
maintenance.why: Catches small failures before water gets behind the wall or into subfloor.
Old caulk shrinks and pulls away even when it still looks fine.
